create_transforms_imagenet_train: create ImageNet-style training transforms with random resized crop, flip, color jitter, and normalization
build_random_resized_crop_and_interpolat: build a RandomResizedCropAndInterpolation class that crops PIL Images to random size with configurable interpolation
